verdict.rationale: Greptile automatically reviews every pull request (event-driven) and lets users configure review triggers, custom rules and per-repo greptile.json settings. It can also route reviews to a different model when a PR was authored by a coding agent. However, the evidence only shows this automation inside the code-review flow: rules shape what the review flags, not arbitrary actions on arbitrary events. Missing for 10: a general-purpose event→action rule engine, documented trigger types and actions beyond PR review, and independent corroboration of trigger configuration.
